subject: QA Risk Brief — 2026-02-23
body:
GA — QA risk brief from this sprint.

## New tests shipped this session
- inline-script-syntax-check.test.js (6/6) — parses index.html, exam.html, final_exam script blocks via node --check
- flake-registry.test.js (10/10) — flake registry schema + blocked suite report
- test-runtime-profile.js — profiles all 33 static suites (baseline: 7.5s total, max 868ms)
- question-type-coverage.test.js (14/14) — type coverage floors across RP1-RP9
- seed-repro-extension.test.js (25/25) — exam_id→seed→order pipeline
- export-import-qa.test.js (34/34) — export/import contract + score file schema
- precommit-guard-audit.test.js (17/17) — meta-audit of pre-commit-check.js

## Risks for GA

1. save-load-audit.test.js FAILS: 'Corrupted localStorage → uncaught JSON.parse exception → silent failure'. The import path in index.html needs a try/catch wrapper around JSON.parse on localStorage values. This is a P2 bug — Kai loses session silently if localStorage gets corrupted.

2. scorecard-contract.test.js was broken: test expected old 'score-big' template. Fixed to match id=scoreBigEl (exam.html:1049). If you change the scorecard HTML structure, update this test.

3. export-import-qa: import code validates data.mcm_scores presence but NOT data.version. If you ever add a v2 format, the import won't detect the version mismatch and will silently load wrong data.

## What I need from you

Please add try/catch around localStorage.parse in the load path and fix the save-load-audit failure. It's 1 line of defensive code.
